title: Tangible Outcomes of Grants Provided Under SMEs Go Digital
what_it_is: Tangible Outcomes of Grants Provided Under SMEs Go Digital

sections.label: SME digital adoption survey findings
sections.summary: Surveys from 2018 to 2022 show more firms adopting digital technology and SMEs Go Digital grants adding value to SMEs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: Between 2018 and 2022, the Annual Survey on Infocomm Usage by Enterprises found that firms which had adopted at least one digital technology increased from 78% to 93%.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: The report found that SMEs Go Digital grants have added value to SMEs and improved their productivity.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: In addition, IMDA's survey showed that 85% of participating SMEs reported time savings, and 75% said digitalisation helped them to alleviate manpower challenges.

sections.label: Digital Enterprise Blueprint and cybersecurity
sections.summary: The Digital Enterprise Blueprint will help companies deepen digitalisation and use new technologies while ensuring they are cybersecure and protect customer data.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Building on this, the Digital Enterprise Blueprint will look at how we can help our companies, including SMEs, deepen their digitalisation and tap on emerging new technologies, like generative AI, cloud-based solutions, while at the same time making sure that they are cybersecure and can also protect their customer data.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: You can invest a lot in digital solutions but if it is not cybersafe and is subject to cybersecurity attacks – and many of our SMEs are not a target but collateral damage – all the hard work and investment over the many years can be wiped out overnight.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: So, even as we help our companies digitalise, we will help them to be cybersecure.

sections.label: Digitalisation and worker mental wellness
sections.summary: The passage asks how digitalisation impacts mental wellness of workers, especially senior workers, and notes the CTO-as-a-Service initiative launched in 2021.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: So, how does digitalisation also impact the mental wellness of the workers, especially senior workers in these firms?

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: We launched the CTO-as-a-Service initiative in 2021, that is, about a couple of years ago.

sections.label: Corppass grants and advisory panel
sections.summary: SMEs can apply grants through Corppass, and a panel of consultants appointed by CSA and PDPA provides cybersecurity and data protection advisory services.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: The second one was to enable SMEs to apply grants through using their Corppass, so that it is more seamless.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: And also, how we put together a panel of consultants appointed by Cyber Security Agency of Singapore (CSA) and the Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA) to provide advisory services related to cybersecurity and data protection.
